mapper.sql: SELECT o.id,o.transfer_no,o.source_warehouse_id,sw.warehouse_name source_warehouse_name,o.target_warehouse_id,tw.warehouse_name target_warehouse_name,o.source_company_id,sd.dept_name source_company_name,o.source_project_id,o.target_company_id,td.dept_name target_company_name,o.target_project_id,o.transfer_type,o.status,o.transfer_at,o.confirmed_at,o.completed_at,o.cancelled_at,o.operator_id,u.nick_name operator_name,o.create_time,o.remark FROM wm_transfer_order o LEFT JOIN wm_warehouse sw ON sw.id=o.source_warehouse_id LEFT JOIN wm_warehouse tw ON tw.id=o.target_warehouse_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept sd ON sd.dept_id=o.source_company_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept td ON td.dept_id=o.target_company_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=o.operator_id

WHERE o.del_flag='0' AND o.source_warehouse_id IN #{id} AND o.target_warehouse_id IN #{id} AND o.transfer_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{bo.transferNo},'%') AND o.source_warehouse_id=#{bo.sourceWarehouseId} AND o.target_warehouse_id=#{bo.targetWarehouseId} AND o.status=#{bo.status} AND o.transfer_type=#{bo.transferType} AND o.transfer_at>=#{bo.beginTransferAt} AND o.transfer_at<=#{bo.endTransferAt}
